name: Streamlined Workspaces
description:
Launch apps where you choose. Swipe to an empty workspace to open Activities.

The top bar shows a pill for your current workspace and dots for other workspaces with windows. With dynamic workspaces, a dot stays visible while an app starts, and you have a free workspace at each end. Swipe toward an empty workspace and the Activities preview follows your fingers, even when you reverse direction. Swipe away while an app starts and its window can still open where you launched it. A single three-finger swipe can dismiss Quick Settings or the calendar and switch workspaces. Window previews follow stacking changes during swipes, and Activities can reopen after a display change at login. With optional system-wide setup, the login screen opens the password prompt when it lists a single account.
